verdict.label: STEP ASIDE — VIX Breaks Below 17; AMD-Microsoft Helios Counters Kimi K3; Wednesday Binary
verdict.headline: Microsoft picks AMD to power new Azure AI infrastructure in boost for chip sector
verdict.rationale_short: S&P 500 closed 7,443 — 17 points below the 7,460 formal trigger — extending the breach into a second session. VIX fell to 16.50, first close below both the 18 and 17 formal thresholds since the Hormuz crisis began, and September hike probability compressed to 48.7%, below 50% for the first time. AMD surged 3.83% on the Microsoft Azure Helios deployment announcement — the first hard hyperscaler demand evidence countering the Kimi K3 AI-capex-disruption thesis since July 17. WTI settled $82.21, below the $84+ morning spike but still $2.21 above the $80 formal trigger. STEP ASIDE maintained at medium conviction: the regime is materially improving across two key triggers, but SPX has not closed above 7,460 and oil remains formally breached.

bear_case: The VIX compression to 16.50 and September hike probability fall to 48.7% are single-session moves on light summer-Monday volume, reactive to Qatar ceasefire optionality rather than evidence of structural resolution. WTI at $82.21 is one Brent overnight spike away from $87-90 again — the $90 intraday print on Monday morning itself demonstrates this vulnerability. The IRGC has previously struck Qatar's own LNG assets in Hormuz, making the Qatar mediator role precarious; if Iran escalates against Qatari infrastructure, September hike probability could reverse through 60% within hours as oil spikes $5-8. AMD's Microsoft Helios win is one deployment contract for H2 2026 — it does not quantify or refute Kimi K3 AI demand disruption at scale. GOOGL's $4.67B EU antitrust fine introduces a new legal overhang entering Q2 earnings, and a Cloud miss on July 22 would overwhelm any vol-compression tailwind. If WTI gaps above $87 AND GOOGL Cloud misses by more than 3% on July 22, the STEP ASIDE call is wrong and BEARISH resumes. Invalidation: If WTI closes above $87 this week AND September hike probability reverses above 60%, STEP ASIDE → BEARISH re-escalation is warranted.
